neighbours.label: the word 'motivation' (also 'motive'): the reason that drives someone to act
fire: For most volunteers the biggest motivation is simply wanting to help their neighbours.
Her coach said that lack of motivation, not talent, was the real problem.
The study asked workers about their motivation for changing careers.
Students with strong intrinsic motivation tend to read more on their own.
Finding the motivation to exercise in winter is hard for many people.
His only motivation for joining the club was to meet new friends.
Teachers often struggle to keep motivation high near the end of term.
The author explains the political motivation behind the new law.
